Overview

Da Lat is a city in Lam Dong with a population of 400,000. Vietnam’s hill station escape, known for its cool year-round climate, French colonial villas, flower gardens, and a romantic atmosphere that draws both tourists and expats. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
